name: Disaggregated - Futures Only
description: This is a report of futures only positions. The Disaggregated reports are broken down by Agriculture and Natural Resource contracts. The Disaggregated reports break down reportable open interest positions into four classifications: Producer/Merchant, Swap Dealers, Managed Money and Other Reportables.
